launchConfirm.label: Confirm a lab launch from the website

title.here: Run this lab on this computer?
title.server: Run this lab on your server?
title.cloud: Run this lab on your cloud account?

body.here: A launch from the website wants to start <lab>{lab}</lab> on this computer. Only approve a launch you started.
body.server: A launch from the website wants to start <lab>{lab}</lab> on <target>{target}</target>. Only approve a launch you started.
body.cloud: A launch from the website wants to start <lab>{lab}</lab> on <target>{target}</target>. This starts billable resources on your account (they auto-stop later). Only approve a launch you started.

launchConfirm.privileged: This lab has privileged machines: they get kernel-level access to the computer that runs them.
launchConfirm.failed: Couldn't send your answer to Cyber CTF
launchConfirm.expired: This request expired: the lab wasn't started. Launch it again from the website if you still want it.

body.one: A lab is being worked on inside the app. Quitting now can leave machines half-created, and a lab on a cloud account keeps billing until it is torn down. Let it finish in the background (the app closes by itself when it is done), keep waiting, or quit anyway. Quitting a second time also quits anyway.
body.other: {count} labs are being worked on inside the app. Quitting now can leave machines half-created, and a lab on a cloud account keeps billing until it is torn down. Let it finish in the background (the app closes by itself when it is done), keep waiting, or quit anyway. Quitting a second time also quits anyway.
